'''Keith Allen''' was named webmaster of the [[Players Committee]] website in the committee's New Advocates announcement, captured 3 June 2004. He was a member of the WebGroup formed then to coordinate the site. The other members named were [[Jason Robinette]], [[David Destefanis]], John Davis, [[Kevin Brownell]] and [[Nick Kolnik]].<ref name="newadv2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603214022/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/NewAdvocates.htm New Advocates! Not 1 but 2!], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 June 2004)</ref>

He wrote that he had been running tournaments for many years, and that he looked forward to articles and other projects.<ref name="newadv2004" />
